# Keian Luxandor

> Keian Luxandor is a fine jewellery brand. This website presents its collections of engagement rings, wedding rings, fine jewellery and gifts, and lets visitors browse pieces, save a wishlist, book an appointment or contact the team.

## Shop

- [Signature Collection](/collections/signature): The Keian Signature Collection.
- [Engagement Rings](/collections/engagement-rings): Engagement ring styles.
- [Wedding Rings](/collections/wedding-rings): Wedding bands and rings.
- [Fine Jewelry](/collections/fine-jewelry): Rings, earrings, necklaces, pendants and bracelets.
- [Rings](/collections/rings): Promise rings and everyday rings.
- [Bracelets](/collections/bracelets): Tennis bracelets and bangles.
- [Gifts](/collections/gifts): Gift ideas for her.

- [About Us](/about-us): The Keian Luxandor story and craftsmanship.
- [Our Promise](/our-values): Warranty, returns, shipping and appointments.
